answer: Bind one sequential memory-hard proof-of-work ticket to every identity per epoch. The computation grinds like a glacier carving a valley: strictly step by step, so one CPU finishes at most one or two tickets per epoch. An attacker wanting a thousand sybils needs a thousand cores burning all epoch, a comet-bright budget dwarfing any farming profit. Verification is milliseconds, and honest agents fold the ticket into normal duty. Limits: botnets or ASIC farms bypass it, so difficulty must retarget against hardware prices, and stolen accounts in the orchard need a separate penalty.
